test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If A ÷ B means that A is the father of B, A × B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the daughter of P?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the Brother of B’.

 
 

 Symbol
 Symbol denoted Relation
 
 

 ÷ 
 Father
 
 

 × 
 Mother
 
 

 +
 Brother
 
 

Find:- expression shows that Q is the daughter of P?

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P ÷ Q × R

(P is the father of Q, and Q is the mother of R.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b33865046b97b0afbc62e28a93440bdacf783b029b44cd338753f8260e76e0c.png] 

Here, Q is the daughter of P. (Correct)

**Option 2) **P ÷ Q + R

(P is the father of Q, and Q is the brother of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/634acefc84b754baf38556f8f3290b7e470c737bea4c89270dd785db2934510f.png] 

Here, Q is the son of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **P × Q ÷ R

(P is the mother of Q and Q is the father of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a695682a2941a2ea0198db37ec47f2843f3c4c71f1d4b312181252ea2e59436.png] 

Here, Q is the son of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P + Q ÷ R

(P is the brother of Q and Q is the father of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c821c1349ea3db232dfa837a83b52648aac2dca694df9effc6348d0caa3ba38.png] 

Here, Q is the brother of P. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
